content: When Mirror_StartSourceNetwork is called to start a FlexRay source bus, the Bus Mirroring module shall call FrIf_EnableBusMirror- ing with FrIf_MirroringActive set to TRUE to start reporting of received and transmitted FlexRay frames from the corresponding FlexRay cluster.

When Mirror_StartSourceNetwork is called to start a FlexRay source bus, the Bus Mirroring module shall call FrIf_EnableBusMirroring with FrIf_MirroringActive set to TRUE to start reporting of received and transmitted FlexRay frames from the corresponding FlexRay cluster.
